CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Learner".invalidate_monthly_actuals(owner_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    offset_index integer;
BEGIN
    IF COALESCE(cardinality(owner_ids), 0) = 0 THEN
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    UPDATE "Learner".learner_monthly_targets t
    SET
        actual_seconds_total = NULL,
        actual_updated_at = NULL,
        actual_summary = NULL
    WHERE t.learner_id = ANY(owner_ids)

      AND t.month_status = 'open'

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM "Learner".learner_monthly_signatures s
          WHERE s.learner_id = t.learner_id
            AND s.report_month = t.report_month
            AND s.review_confirmed IS TRUE
            AND s.source_system = 'lms'
            AND s.source_ref LIKE 'lms-monthly:%'
      )

      AND (
          SELECT e.event_type
          FROM "Learner".manual_month_finalization_events e
          WHERE e.learner_id = t.learner_id
            AND e.report_month = t.report_month
          ORDER BY e.id DESC
          LIMIT 1
      ) IS DISTINCT FROM 'finalized'

      AND (
          t.actual_seconds_total IS NOT NULL
          OR t.actual_updated_at IS NOT NULL
          OR t.actual_summary IS NOT NULL
      );

    FOR offset_index IN 1..cardinality(owner_ids) BY 200
    LOOP
        PERFORM pg_notify(
            'lms_monthly_actuals_changed',
            to_json(
                owner_ids[offset_index:offset_index+199]
            )::text
        );
    END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Learner".sync_journal_document_to_activity_ssot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    linked_progress_id BIGINT;
BEGIN
    SELECT j.progress_id
    INTO STRICT linked_progress_id
    FROM "Learner".learner_journal_rows j
    WHERE j.id = NEW.manual_activity_id
      AND j.learner_id = NEW.learner_id;

    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
        UPDATE "Learner".learner_activity_documents s
        SET
            container = NEW.container,
            blob_name = NEW.blob_name,
            display_name = NEW.display_name,
            content_type = COALESCE(NEW.content_type, ''),
            size_bytes = NEW.size_bytes,
            uploaded_by = COALESCE(NEW.uploaded_by, ''),
            uploaded_at = NEW.uploaded_at,
            deleted_at = CASE
                WHEN OLD.deleted_at IS NULL
                 AND NEW.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
                THEN COALESCE(s.deleted_at, NEW.deleted_at)
                ELSE s.deleted_at
            END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE s.source_system = 'journal'
          AND s.source_document_id =
              'manual-document:' || NEW.id::TEXT
          AND s.learner_id = NEW.learner_id;

        IF FOUND THEN
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO "Learner".learner_activity_documents (
        learner_id,
        progress_id,
        source_system,
        source_document_id,
        container,
        blob_name,
        display_name,
        content_type,
        size_bytes,
        uploaded_by,
        uploaded_at,
        deleted_at,
        created_at,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES (
        NEW.learner_id,
        linked_progress_id,
        'journal',
        'manual-document:' || NEW.id::TEXT,
        NEW.container,
        NEW.blob_name,
        NEW.display_name,
        COALESCE(NEW.content_type, ''),
        NEW.size_bytes,
        COALESCE(NEW.uploaded_by, ''),
        NEW.uploaded_at,
        NEW.deleted_at,
        COALESCE(NEW.uploaded_at, NOW()),
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (source_system, source_document_id)
    DO NOTHING;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "Learner".monthly_actual_event_16()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    owner_ids bigint[];
BEGIN

    IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN

        SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT learner_id ORDER BY learner_id)
        INTO owner_ids
        FROM new_rows
        WHERE learner_id IS NOT NULL;

    ELSIF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN

        SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT learner_id ORDER BY learner_id)
        INTO owner_ids
        FROM old_rows
        WHERE learner_id IS NOT NULL;

    ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN

        WITH changed AS (
            (
                SELECT id, learner_id, report_month, event_type
                FROM new_rows

                EXCEPT

                SELECT id, learner_id, report_month, event_type
                FROM old_rows
            )
            UNION
            (
                SELECT id, learner_id, report_month, event_type
                FROM old_rows

                EXCEPT

                SELECT id, learner_id, report_month, event_type
                FROM new_rows
            )
        )
        SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT learner_id ORDER BY learner_id)
        INTO owner_ids
        FROM changed
        WHERE learner_id IS NOT NULL;

    END IF;

    PERFORM "Learner".invalidate_monthly_actuals(owner_ids);

    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
